2026-10-27 04:06:05.385996 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-27 04:06:05.386000 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-27 04:06:05.386017 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-27 04:06:05.386033 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-27 04:06:05.386592 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-27 04:06:05.386607 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-10-27 04:06:05.386618 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
2026-10-27 04:06:05.386623 | controller | • In case of template units, the unit is meant to be enabled with some
2026-10-27 04:06:05.386632 | controller |   instance name specified.
